findings.summary: Redaction responsibility is scattered: the transport layer (github.raw) redacts, build.collect redacts extra catalogs, __main__ redacts data.json and html.render redacts again, so no single stage owns M5 and a new output path can silently skip it.

_packages returns rows whose second element is either a counts dict or a sentinel string (STATE_UNKNOWN / EMPTY_CELL) and _package_sections discriminates with isinstance(counts, str); presentation state is encoded in the data type and inferred from empty packages/None stability instead of an explicit model field.

The model shape consumed by html.render is documented only in the html.py docstring while build.assemble builds the dict inline; the two modules share an implicit untyped contract, so a renamed key in build fails only at render time (html uses .get defaults that mask omissions).
findings.effect: A key rename in the model could silently render an empty section in the dashboard rather than failing.

findings.summary: The CLI builds the out/raw/<module>/api/state.csv layout using build.STATE_FILE, so the on-disk layout that acceptance tests read is split between __main__ and build instead of one writer owning output paths.
